commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text:
Her modesty holds her back, so she gives up going, and she says this.

Good heart, if you won’t give up modesty, give up desire. If you won’t give up that, give up modesty. If you mean to keep both, I haven’t the strength to carry two opposites at once, even if you have. She calls the heart good because keeping both preserves a woman’s womanhood. That is good, but her life can’t stand it.
